description: We are a motivated and collaborative team interested in learning, solving problems, and developing new skills. We are looking for team members who are responsible, creative, and willing to communicate and contribute actively. We value teamwork, different perspectives, and a positive attitude. No matter your background or experience level, we welcome people who are motivated to learn and work together.
summary:
We developed AstroHack Browser, a custom, sci-fi-themed web environment that transforms the standard browser new tab page into an interactive space exploration hub. It features an immersive dark-mode UI, a custom app dock, and a built-in asteroid mini-game called "Echoes Rebirth."

To address the challenge of making complex historical data accessible, we gamified the experience. As players engage in the arcade-style game, they unlock hidden artifacts and narratives documenting the Apollo 11 moon landing and the Mars Opportunity rover's legacy.

This project is important because it bridges the gap between dry, complex NASA archives and public engagement. By blending interactive entertainment with education, AstroHack honors the legacy of past space pioneers while inspiring the next generation of explorers to actively engage with space science.
details:
• How it works: AstroHack Browser is a custom web space. It features a mini-game where you shoot asteroids. While playing, you unlock real stories and data about Apollo 11 and the Opportunity rover.
  • Benefits: It makes learning about space fun and easy. It works right in your browser with no downloads needed.
  • Intended Impact: To inspire people of all ages by turning complex space history into an exciting, interactive game.
  • Tools Used: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Canvas API, and SVG graphics.
  • Creativity: Instead of a normal website, we built a "spaceship cockpit" experience that mixes arcade gaming with education.
  • Factors Considered: We followed all NASA rules strictly (watermarking AI content, removing NASA logos, citing data). We also made sure the game is fast, easy to use, and works on all screens.
